data.name: UpdateSourceDescription
data.value: Controls where update information is fetched from. GitHub Releases is the default source; anonymous access is subject to GitHub API rate limits.
data.comment: 更新源-描述

data.name: UpdateSourceGitHubFallback
data.value: GitHub Releases (falls back to the ClassIsland distribution center on failure)
data.comment: 更新源-"GitHub Releases（失败时回退）"选项

data.name: UpdateSourceDistributionCenterCompat
data.comment: 更新源-"ClassIsland 分发中心（兼容，不推荐）"选项

data.name: UpdateSourceExplanation
data.value: GitHub Releases reads published versions directly from the ClassFabric GitHub repository, without depending on the ClassIsland distribution center. When an option with "fallback" is selected and the GitHub check fails, the ClassIsland distribution center (kept for compatibility) is used instead.
data.comment: 更新源-补充说明

data.name: UpdateChannel
data.comment: 更新设置-"更新通道"

data.name: UpdateChannelDescription
data.value: Controls the target version the app updates to. ClassFabric currently ships mainly preview builds, so the preview channel is the default. Release cadence and stability vary between channels; some channels may contain unstable features, use them with caution.
data.comment: 更新通道-描述

data.name: ForceCheckUpdateDescription
data.value: Force the app to update to the latest version on the current channel, even if that version is older than the current one.
